FiveIsland_Meadow_SteelDen_Text_GuardsLe.en: The beast does not stir.\nIts guardians still stand watch.
FiveIsland_Meadow_SteelDen_Text_GuardsLe.fr: La bête ne bouge pas.\nSes gardiens veillent toujours.

FiveIsland_Meadow_SteelDen_Text_T0Intro.en: Steel does not rust, and neither\ndoes our watch.
FiveIsland_Meadow_SteelDen_Text_T0Intro.fr: L'acier ne rouille pas, et notre\nveille non plus.

FiveIsland_Meadow_SteelDen_Text_T1Intro.en: The ancient one hums when the\nsky cracks. We keep it quiet.
FiveIsland_Meadow_SteelDen_Text_T1Intro.fr: L'ancien gronde quand le ciel se\nfend. Nous le gardons silencieux.

FiveIsland_Meadow_SteelDen_Text_T1Post.en: Keep going. It only gets harder.
FiveIsland_Meadow_SteelDen_Text_T1Post.fr: Continue. Ça ne fait que se corser.

FiveIsland_Meadow_SteelDen_Text_T2Intro.en: No one walks to the shore alone\nanymore.
FiveIsland_Meadow_SteelDen_Text_T2Intro.fr: Plus personne ne marche seul vers\nle rivage.

FiveIsland_Meadow_SteelDen_Text_T2Post.en: The WARDEN has heard you coming.

FiveIsland_Meadow_SteelDen_Text_T3Intro.en: The beast gave us shelter when\nthe sky turned. We stay for it.
FiveIsland_Meadow_SteelDen_Text_T3Intro.fr: La bête nous a abrités quand le\nciel a tourné. Nous restons pour\lelle.

FiveIsland_Meadow_SteelDen_Text_T3Post.fr: Presque arrivé. Fais attention à\nton orgueil.

FiveIsland_Meadow_SteelDen_Text_T4Intro.en: I am the WARDEN of the STEEL.\nThe beast sleeps in my care.\pProve that your will is worth\nmore than my fear.
FiveIsland_Meadow_SteelDen_Text_T4Intro.fr: Je suis le GARDIEN de l'ACIER.\nLa bête dort sous ma garde.\pProuve que ta volonté vaut plus que\nma peur.

FiveIsland_Meadow_SteelDen_Text_T4Post.en: Go. Do not let it rust.
FiveIsland_Meadow_SteelDen_Text_T4Post.fr: Va. Ne le laisse pas rouiller.
